chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from some of our companions, from Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him), who said:

Among what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) bequeathed to Ali (peace be upon him) was that he said to him: 'O Ali! Upon you is the gourd, so eat it, for it increases the brain and the intellect.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad recommend Ali to eat for brain health?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* through the chain of the Six Companions, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s specific medical advice to Imam Ali, emphasizing the gourd's (*al-dubba'*) role in enhancing cerebral function and intellect. This narration is significant in Shia tradition as it underscores the integration of spiritual leadership with practical health wisdom, reflecting the Prophet's holistic care for the Ahl al-Bayt's well-being. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the prophetic endorsement of natural remedies for cognitive vitality.
